g.title: agentdeps
g.text: serf `agent` package (70 files) — concern-level packaging is blocked by one dependency knot
13 of 14 concern-clusters form a single strongly-connected core. Only `events` is cleanly extractable today.
The knot is held shut by FOUR direct back-cycles into session (red). Sever those (via interface seams) and the core falls apart.

g.title: cluster_core
g.text: ENTANGLED CORE — one strongly-connected component (~60 of 70 files)
No package boundary inside this box is cycle-free without first introducing interfaces.

g.title: rim
g.text: FILE-LEVEL EXTRACTABLE RIM (the hope inside the knot)
~37 of 70 files reference NO session symbol, yet session-core uses them.
11 PURE leaves (reference no other agent file at all) — move today:
Near-leaves (ref only non-session files; need a transitive-closure check):
Extract these as agent/internal/* lower packages INDIVIDUALLY — never a whole
concern-cluster, because each cluster has at least one file that touches session.
